rationale: Three reachable defects remain: a 404 lookup can leave a deleted ID selected, options-load failure is misrepresented as an empty list and marked loaded, and overlapping project requests can let stale results replace the active filter results. Seven speculative, unconfirmed, stylistic, or low-impact candidates were dismissed; verification-gap lens output was not supplied, so coverage is incomplete and confidence is low.

findings.title: Stale 404 lookup leaves selection
findings.problem: When a selected value changes while its missing-label lookup is in flight, effect cleanup sets active=false. A later 404 yields no label state update and its removal callback is discarded; resolvingIdsRef is cleared without retriggering the effect.
findings.impact: The stale cost-center ID remains selected and is sent as cost_center_ids, so the project list can be filtered by a deleted center.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile the 404 against the current selected IDs when the lookup settles, rather than discarding it because the originating effect was cleaned up.

findings.title: Failed options request appears empty
findings.problem: The loadOptions catch clears options; finally then marks hasLoaded true. The UI consequently renders its ordinary no-results/empty message and handleShow will not automatically retry.
findings.impact: A server/network failure is presented to users as a valid empty cost-center list and leaves no normal reopen retry path.
findings.recommendation: Expose the load failure distinctly and keep the option list retryable instead of treating failure as a successful empty result.

findings.title: Stale project response overwrites active filter
findings.problem: indexProjects unconditionally writes each response to shared projects and pagination state; there is no ordering guard. ProjectsManagementFull can issue a new request on selection change while a prior request remains in flight.
findings.impact: If the older response resolves last, the visible project list no longer matches the selected cost-center filter.
findings.recommendation: Prevent a stale indexProjects response from replacing the projects and pagination state produced by a newer request.
